title: gos self-verify --json
description: Result of verifying the running gos script against its release. ok=false exits 4.

version.description: Running gos version, without v prefix.

path.description: Resolved path of the running script.

expected_sha256.description: Digest published in the release checksums.txt.

attestation.description: verified by gh attestation, failed, or unavailable (no gh, not authenticated, or checksum mismatch).

attestation_detail.description: Last line of gh's output when the attestation was not verified; empty otherwise.

ok.description: True when the checksum matches and the attestation did not fail.
